title: R. A. Wood Associates
description:
R. A. Wood Associates is a consulting firm that specializes in innovative engineering solutions in RF and microwave systems design and manufacturing. Their services include engineering consulting, prototypes, automated test system design, software development, and training classes. They offer a range of RF and microwave components such as equalizers, attenuators, and amplifiers suitable for various applications. The company aims to serve industries requiring advanced RF and microwave technology, providing both consulting and production manufacturing services. 
The company headquarters is located in 164 Industrial Park Drive, Frankfort, NY 13340, United States.
11-50 Employees
